title: Generation Growth Capital, Inc. Announces Investment in Select Food Products, Inc. to Support Merger With Tino's Italian Specialty Foods
主要内容: Generation Growth Capital, Inc. invested in Select Food Products, Inc. to support its merger with Tino's Italian Specialty Foods, LLC. The investment aimed to recapitalize the company and facilitate the merger. Senior financing was provided by Anchor Bank, N.A., and mezzanine financing by EXMARQ Capital Partners, Inc. The Platinum Group acted as the exclusive advisor to Select Foods on the deal. Select Foods is a custom food manufacturer specializing in sandwich, breakfast, snack, and dessert categories. Tino's is a manufacturer of calzones, artisan subs, paninis, pizza, condiments, and breakfast and lunch options for the convenience service industry. The merger is expected to provide Tino's with immediate access to Select Foods' manufacturing capacity, enhancing the combined company's ability to offer innovative products across retail grocery, foodservice, and convenience store channels. Scott Robertson, CEO of Select Foods, expressed confidence in the partnership, stating that the T. brand is poised for growth. Tino Lettieri, who will assume the role of Tino's Brand Manager and Head of Research and Development for Select Foods, emphasized the merger's potential to provide manufacturing capacity and quality.
